label: FUS::DDIT3

sections.text: FUS encodes an RNA-binding protein involved in RNA processing and transcriptional regulation.
DDIT3 encodes CHOP, a stress-responsive bZIP transcription factor.

The fusion joins a FET-family activation region to DDIT3, creating an abnormal transcription factor that disrupts adipocytic differentiation. FUS::DDIT3 supports the diagnosis of myxoid liposarcoma; FUS is the usual partner and EWSR1 is less common.

Trabectedin has a US histology-based indication for adults with unresectable or metastatic liposarcoma after an anthracycline-containing regimen; DDIT3 fusion status is not the sole eligibility criterion.
